ListQuery Helper
nodes.rationale: Shared Helper Pattern - 6 controllers need identical sort resolution, total and nulls-last ordering; without a helper each controller duplicates the logic and it is never consolidated.

nodes.label: Sort Allowlist per Controller
nodes.rationale: Sorting is allowed only for whitelisted columns; any invalid or dangerous value silently falls back to a default (created_at DESC, or a caller-supplied default for public endpoints) to avoid 422/500 and injection.

nodes.label: Nulls-last ordering (portable)
nodes.rationale: Expression (col IS NULL) ASC, col DIR, id DESC keeps null ordering identical on SQLite (tests) and PostgreSQL (runtime).

nodes.label: Admin Table Readability Spec
nodes.rationale: Defines the sort-allowlist, offset-cursor contract, top-level meta.total, summary strip, nulls-last, density and dummy-parity rules that every task implements.

nodes.label: Design Decision: Option B (Full Paging)
nodes.rationale: Chosen to give a uniform offset-cursor plus top-level meta.total contract across all admin list endpoints, enabling consistent paging/sort/summary UI in one generic Table component.

nodes.label: admin-table.ts Helper
nodes.rationale: Shared Helper Pattern - 6 dummy listDummy branches and 6 page components need an identical comparator/sort/paginate/format; without it each page writes its own copy. SORT_ALLOWLISTS mirrors the backend allowlist as a single documented source of truth.

nodes.label: TableDensity type
nodes.rationale: TableDensity = 'compact' | 'default' | 'comfortable' drives row padding and is persisted in localStorage.

nodes.label: Table.tsx Generic Contract
nodes.rationale: Table is the single table component used by 6 pages; upgrading it in one place (optional props, aria-sort, density) lowers duplication risk while keeping the existing columns/rows/rowKey/empty contract backward compatible.

nodes.label: useTableDensity hook
nodes.rationale: Initial density is default on server render; localStorage key admin:table-density is read only in useEffect to avoid hydration mismatch.

nodes.label: Offset Cursor Contract
nodes.rationale: Option B (Full Paging) with a uniform offset cursor so all admin lists share one paging contract; promotions and sales-performance convert from id-based cursor to offset.

nodes.label: meta.total Contract
nodes.rationale: Total is a COUNT with the same filters; meta is normalized to top-level (has_more/limit/cursor/total/summary) while data stays an array for frontend compatibility.

nodes.label: Dummy Mode Zustand Store + Factory
nodes.rationale: Option A (Zustand singleton store + per-API-function guard) chosen over global fetch override (fails relational invariant) and page-level swapped components (bypasses the aggregation/chart functions that must be verified). One seeded factory builds a single relational graph consumed by all menus.

nodes.label: Dummy-mode Parity
nodes.rationale: Dummy data must flow through the same functions as real data so downstream aggregation/chart functions are actually exercised; determinism makes a wrong chart a code bug rather than data noise.

nodes.label: Phase 7 MVP Completion
nodes.rationale: Incremental service-layer extension with dedicated controllers per domain; string-role enum kept instead of spatie RBAC to minimize migration risk. Created the AdminOutlet/UserRole/Promotion/Order/Product/SalesPerformance controllers that this plan upgrades.
